companies.name: ユニバーサル・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: 空調分野の顧客の一社としてキヤリアを挙げる
relations.text_en: Lists Carrier among its climate control customers

source.label: Universal Electronics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In climate control, Daikin Industries Ltd., Fujitsu General, Mitsubishi Electric, LG HVAC and Carrier Global Corporation are customers that represent top market share leaders in the global HVAC industry.

relations.text: Watscoの仕入れの62%がキヤリア製品
relations.text_en: 62% of Watsco's purchases come from Carrier

source.label: Watsco 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's top ten suppliers accounted for 85% of our purchases, including 62% from Carrier and 8% from Rheem.

relations.text: 販売合弁Carrier Enterpriseを共同で運営
relations.text_en: Runs the Carrier Enterprise distribution joint ventures with Carrier

source.label: Carrier 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We sell our products and services through certain key distributor, joint venture and similar relationships, including the Carrier Enterprise joint ventures with Watsco, Inc., AHI-Carrier FZC, a United Arab Emirates-based joint venture and various joint ventures with members of the Midea Group.

relations.text: 複数の合弁を通じて製品を販売
relations.text_en: Sells through various joint ventures with Midea Group members

source.label: Carrier 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We sell our products and services through certain key distributor, joint venture and similar relationships, including the Carrier Enterprise joint ventures with Watsco, Inc., AHI-Carrier FZC, a United Arab Emirates-based joint venture and various joint ventures with members of the Midea Group.

relations.text: 空調事業(VCS)を142億ドルで買収し、対価の一部として株式を発行
relations.text_en: Bought its climate solutions business for $14.2 billion, partly paid in Carrier shares

source.label: Carrier 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 2, 2024, the Company completed the acquisition of the VCS Business from Viessmann for total consideration of $ 14.2 billion.

relations.text: 旧親会社UTCからの分離時に結んだ分離契約・税務契約の当事者
relations.text_en: Party with Carrier to the separation and tax agreements from the UTC split

source.label: Otis 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Separation, as further described in Note 1, "Business Overview", was completed pursuant to a Separation and Distribution Agreement ("Separation Agreement") and other agreements with our former parent, UTC, and Carrier Global Corporation ("Carrier")

relations.text: 防火・セキュリティ事業(Chubb Fire & Security)をAPiに売却
relations.text_en: Sold its Chubb Fire & Security business to APi Group

source.label: Carrier 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On July 26, 2021, the Company entered into a stock purchase agreement to sell its Chubb Fire and Security business ("Chubb") to APi Group Corporation ("APi").

companies.sub: 空気から水をつくる装置

relations.text: 商用化で提携(GE Vernovaと並ぶ)

source.label: AirJoule Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: (NYSE: GEV) and our commercial partnerships with Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR) and TenX Investment in Energy Enterprises & Management Co.

relations.text: AAONが10-Kで、主な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: AAON names Carrier among its primary competitors

source.label: AAON 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our AAON branded products primarily compete with Lennox (Lennox International, Inc.), Trane (Trane Technologies plc), York International (Johnson Controls International PLC), Carrier (Carrier Global Corporation), and Daikin

companies.name: グリーン・サークル・デカーボナイズ

relations.text: チラー分野で間接的に競合する大手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Carrier among conventional chiller suppliers it competes with indirectly

source.label: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology 20-F
source.quote: We also compete indirectly with other conventional chiller plant suppliers and energy saving companies, including but not limited to Carrier Global Corporation, Johnson Controls International Plc., and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Group.
